howto: Pick a critter and race three rivals down a 900 m 3D track after the 3-2-1 countdown.
Jump rocks, logs, spikes and gaps; slide under branches and pipes.
Run into crates for an item (lightning, glove, saw, mine, boost or shield) and use it on your rivals.
First across the line wins; your best winning time is saved.
tips: Jump again in the air for a double jump.
Bounce mushrooms launch you high: land clear of the next obstacle.
Lightning stuns everyone ahead of you, so it is best when you are behind.
Drop a mine when a rival is right on your tail.
Mud slows you for a moment; rivals behind you speed up to catch you, so keep moving.

controls.keyboard: Enter or Space starts a race. Space, W or Up to jump (again in the air to double jump), S or Down to slide, F or Shift to use an item, M mute. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Jump, slide and item buttons at the bottom; tap the item slot to use an item.

difficulty: Easy, Normal and Hard on the title set the rivals' pace (7% slower on Easy, 5% faster on Hard). Rivals also rubber-band around you, so the pack stays close.

cheats.effect: A new item the moment you use one

settings.quality: Title screen: GRAPHICS HIGH (sharp pixels and shadows) or LOW (faster), remembered

features.position-or-lap-hud: Place (1st to 4th) top left with a progress bar showing every racer, and the race timer top right
features.results-with-time: The results list every finisher's time (or metres behind) and your place
features.best-time-or-ghost: Best winning time on the title and the results, with NEW BEST TIME
features.results: YOU WIN! or PLACE card with all four results, best time and Restart
features.tutorial: First race: three prompts (jump, slide, use an item), each cleared by doing it; Skip, and Replay tutorial in How to play
features.hints: Hint names the next obstacle and its distance, or how to use the item you hold
